title: The Assassination of Trotsky
writer: Masolino D'Amico, Nicholas Mosley, Franco Solinas
actors: Richard Burton, Alain Delon, Romy Schneider
plot: After Stalin exiles Trotsky to Mexico in 1940, he sends assassin Frank Jacson to infiltrate Trotsky's circle and assassinate him, posing as a young communist to gain access to Trotsky's home.
